_doc: CipherChat v5 - INSECURE upper bound (RLWE error e = 0, no bootstrapping). Model and approximations come from cipherchat/v3/config.json; only the CKKS parameters and the slot layout differ. See docs/V5.md.

ckks.security_note: NONE: with e = 0 the secret key is -b/a mod q. No log QP bound applies; these parameters are not secure for any N.
